WebSite.label: Website
WebSite.comment: A WebSite is a set of related web pages and other items typically served from a single web domain and accessible via URLs.

WebPage.label: Web page
WebPage.comment: A web page. Every web page is implicitly assumed to be declared to be of type WebPage, so the various properties about that webpage, such as breadcrumb may be used. We recommend explicit declaration if these properties are specified, but if they are found outs

SearchResultsPage.label: Search results page
SearchResultsPage.comment: Web page type: Search results page.

QAPage.label: Q&A page
QAPage.comment: A QAPage is a WebPage focussed on a specific Question and its Answer(s), e.g. in a question answering site or documenting Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs).

ItemPage.label: Item page
ItemPage.comment: A page devoted to a single item, such as a particular product or hotel.

FAQPage.label: FAQ page
FAQPage.comment: A FAQPage is a WebPage presenting one or more "Frequently asked questions" (see also QAPage).

google.note: Since August 2023 Google shows FAQ rich results only for well-known, authoritative government and health websites.

MedicalWebPage.label: Medical web page
MedicalWebPage.comment: A web page that provides medical information.

Article.label: Article
Article.comment: An article, such as a news article or piece of investigative report. Newspapers and magazines have articles of many different types and this is intended to cover them all.\n\nSee also blog post.

NewsArticle.label: News article
NewsArticle.comment: A NewsArticle is an article whose content reports news, or provides background context and supporting materials for understanding the news. A more detailed overview of schema.org News markup is also available.

ReportageNewsArticle.label: Reportage news article
ReportageNewsArticle.comment: The ReportageNewsArticle type is a subtype of NewsArticle representing news articles which are the result of journalistic news reporting conventions. In practice many news publishers produce a wide variety of article types, many of which might be considered a

AnalysisNewsArticle.label: Analysis news article
AnalysisNewsArticle.comment: An AnalysisNewsArticle is a NewsArticle that, while based on factual reporting, incorporates the expertise of the author/producer, offering interpretations and conclusions.

OpinionNewsArticle.label: Opinion news article
OpinionNewsArticle.comment: An OpinionNewsArticle is a NewsArticle that primarily expresses opinions rather than journalistic reporting of news and events. For example, a NewsArticle consisting of a column or Blog/BlogPosting entry in the Opinions section of a news publication.

BackgroundNewsArticle.label: Background news article
BackgroundNewsArticle.comment: A NewsArticle providing historical context, definition and detail on a specific topic (aka "explainer" or "backgrounder"). For example, an in-depth article or frequently-asked-questions (FAQ) document on topics such as Climate Change or the European Union. Oth

ReviewNewsArticle.label: Review news article
ReviewNewsArticle.comment: A NewsArticle and CriticReview providing a professional critic's assessment of a service, product, performance, or artistic or literary work.

LiveBlogPosting.label: Live blog posting
LiveBlogPosting.comment: A LiveBlogPosting is a BlogPosting intended to provide a rolling textual coverage of an ongoing event through continuous updates.

Report.label: Report
Report.comment: A Report generated by governmental or non-governmental organization.

TechArticle.label: Technical article
TechArticle.comment: A technical article - Example: How-to (task) topics, step-by-step, procedural troubleshooting, specifications, etc.

DiscussionForumPosting.label: Discussion forum posting
DiscussionForumPosting.comment: A posting to a discussion forum.

Review.label: Review
Review.comment: A review of an item - for example, of a restaurant, movie, or store.

google.note: Self-serving reviews of your own business or organisation are not eligible.

ClaimReview.label: Claim review
ClaimReview.comment: A fact-checking review of claims made (or reported) in some creative work (referenced via itemReviewed).

google.note: Google phased out Claim Review rich results in 2025. Other fact-check consumers may still read it.

CreativeWork.label: Creative work
CreativeWork.comment: The most generic kind of creative work, including books, movies, photographs, software programs, etc.

HowTo.label: How-to
HowTo.comment: Instructions that explain how to achieve a result by performing a sequence of steps.

google.note: Google stopped showing How-to rich results in September 2023. The markup is still valid Schema.org.

DefinedTerm.label: Defined term
DefinedTerm.comment: A word, name, acronym, phrase, etc. with a formal definition. Often used in the context of category or subject classification, glossaries or dictionaries, product or creative work types, etc. Use the name property for the term being defined, use termCode if th

Dataset.label: Dataset
Dataset.comment: A body of structured information describing some topic(s) of interest.

Organization.label: Organization
Organization.comment: An organization such as a school, NGO, corporation, club, etc.

LocalBusiness.label: Local business
LocalBusiness.comment: A particular physical business or branch of an organization. Examples of LocalBusiness include a restaurant, a particular branch of a restaurant chain, a branch of a bank, a medical practice, a club, a bowling alley, etc.

ProfessionalService.label: Professional service
ProfessionalService.comment: Original definition: "provider of professional services."\n\nThe general ProfessionalService type for local businesses was deprecated due to confusion with Service. For reference, the types that it included were: Dentist, AccountingService, Attorney, Notary, a

OnlineBusiness.label: Online business
OnlineBusiness.comment: A particular online business, either standalone or the online part of a broader organization. Examples include an eCommerce site, an online travel booking site, an online learning site, an online logistics and shipping provider, an online (virtual) doctor, etc

SportsOrganization.label: Sports organization
SportsOrganization.comment: Represents the collection of all sports organizations, including sports teams, governing bodies, and sports associations.

NewsMediaOrganization.label: News media organization
NewsMediaOrganization.comment: A News/Media organization such as a newspaper or TV station.

CollegeOrUniversity.label: College or university
CollegeOrUniversity.comment: A college, university, or other third-level educational institution.

MedicalOrganization.label: Medical organization
MedicalOrganization.comment: A medical organization (physical or not), such as hospital, institution or clinic.

Person.label: Person
Person.comment: A person (alive, dead, undead, or fictional).

MedicalBusiness.label: Medical business
MedicalBusiness.comment: A particular physical or virtual business of an organization for medical purposes. Examples of MedicalBusiness include different businesses run by health professionals.

MedicalClinic.label: Medical clinic
MedicalClinic.comment: A facility, often associated with a hospital or medical school, that is devoted to the specific diagnosis and/or healthcare. Previously limited to outpatients but with evolution it may be open to inpatients as well.

Physician.label: Physician
Physician.comment: An individual physician or a physician's office considered as a MedicalOrganization.

MedicalCondition.label: Medical condition
MedicalCondition.comment: Any condition of the human body that affects the normal functioning of a person, whether physically or mentally. Includes diseases, injuries, disabilities, disorders, syndromes, etc.

MedicalProcedure.label: Medical procedure
MedicalProcedure.comment: A process of care used in either a diagnostic, therapeutic, preventive or palliative capacity that relies on invasive (surgical), non-invasive, or other techniques.

Drug.label: Drug
Drug.comment: A chemical or biologic substance, used as a medical therapy, that has a physiological effect on an organism. Here the term drug is used interchangeably with the term medicine although clinical knowledge makes a clear difference between them.

MedicalSpecialty.label: Medical specialty
MedicalSpecialty.comment: Any specific branch of medical science or practice. Medical specialities include clinical specialties that pertain to particular organ systems and their respective disease states, as well as allied health specialties. Enumerated type.

Product.label: Product
Product.comment: Any offered product or service. For example: a pair of shoes; a concert ticket; the rental of a car; a haircut; or an episode of a TV show streamed online.

ProductGroup.label: Product group
ProductGroup.comment: A ProductGroup represents a group of Products that vary only in certain well-described ways, such as by size, color, material etc. While a ProductGroup itself is not directly offered for sale, the various varying products that it represents can be. The Product

IndividualProduct.label: Individual product
IndividualProduct.comment: A single, identifiable product instance (e.g. a laptop with a particular serial number).

Offer.label: Offer
Offer.comment: An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service — for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book.\n\nNote: As the businessFunct

AggregateOffer.label: Aggregate offer
AggregateOffer.comment: When a single product is associated with multiple offers (for example, the same pair of shoes is offered by different merchants), then AggregateOffer can be used.\n\nNote: AggregateOffers are normally expected to associate multiple offers that all share the sa

AggregateRating.label: Aggregate rating
AggregateRating.comment: The average rating based on multiple ratings or reviews.

Brand.label: Brand
Brand.comment: A brand is a name used by an organization or business person for labeling a product, product group, or similar.

MerchantReturnPolicy.label: Merchant return policy
MerchantReturnPolicy.comment: A MerchantReturnPolicy provides information about product return policies associated with an Organization, Product, or Offer.

OfferShippingDetails.label: Offer shipping details
OfferShippingDetails.comment: OfferShippingDetails represents information about shipping destinations. Multiple of these entities can be used to represent different shipping rates for different destinations: One entity for Alaska/Hawaii. A different one for continental US. A different one

Course.label: Course
Course.comment: A description of an educational course which may be offered as distinct instances which take place at different times or take place at different locations, or be offered through different media or modes of study. An educational course is a sequence of one or m

google.note: Google phased out Course Info rich results in 2025 (June 2025 announcement). Course markup is still valid Schema.org.

CourseInstance.label: Course instance
CourseInstance.comment: An instance of a Course which is distinct from other instances because it is offered at a different time or location or through different media or modes of study or to a specific section of students.

LearningResource.label: Learning resource
LearningResource.comment: The LearningResource type can be used to indicate CreativeWorks (whether physical or digital) that have a particular and explicit orientation towards learning, education, skill acquisition, and other educational purposes. LearningResource is expected to be use

Quiz.label: Quiz
Quiz.comment: Quiz: A test of knowledge, skills and abilities.

EducationalOccupationalProgram.label: Educational occupational program
EducationalOccupationalProgram.comment: A program offered by an institution which determines the learning progress to achieve an outcome, usually a credential like a degree or certificate. This would define a discrete set of opportunities (e.g., job, courses) that together constitute a program with

Hotel.label: Hotel
Hotel.comment: A hotel is an establishment that provides lodging paid on a short-term basis (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hotel). See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of a

LodgingBusiness.label: Lodging business
LodgingBusiness.comment: A lodging business, such as a motel, hotel, or inn.

Menu.label: Menu
Menu.comment: A structured representation of food or drink items available from a FoodEstablishment.

MenuSection.label: Menu section
MenuSection.comment: A sub-grouping of food or drink items in a menu. E.g. courses (such as 'Dinner', 'Breakfast', etc.), specific type of dishes (such as 'Meat', 'Vegan', 'Drinks', etc.), or some other classification made by the menu provider.

MenuItem.label: Menu item
MenuItem.comment: A food or drink item listed in a menu or menu section.

Recipe.label: Recipe
Recipe.comment: A recipe. For dietary restrictions covered by the recipe, a few common restrictions are enumerated via suitableForDiet. The keywords property can also be used to add more detail.

Event.label: Event
Event.comment: An event happening at a certain time and location, such as a concert, lecture, or festival. Ticketing information may be added via the offers property. Repeated events may be structured as separate Event objects.

ExhibitionEvent.label: Exhibition event
ExhibitionEvent.comment: Event type: Exhibition event, e.g. at a museum, library, archive, tradeshow, ...

ScreeningEvent.label: Screening event
ScreeningEvent.comment: A screening of a movie or other video.

PerformingGroup.label: Performing group
PerformingGroup.comment: A performance group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a circus.

VideoGame.label: Video game
VideoGame.comment: A video game is an electronic game that involves human interaction with a user interface to generate visual feedback on a video device.

TouristAttraction.label: Tourist attraction
TouristAttraction.comment: A tourist attraction. In principle any Thing can be a TouristAttraction, from a Mountain and LandmarksOrHistoricalBuildings to a LocalBusiness. This Type can be used on its own to describe a general TouristAttraction, or be used as an additionalType to add tou

Residence.label: Residence
Residence.comment: The place where a person lives.

Apartment.label: Apartment
Apartment.comment: An apartment (in American English) or flat (in British English) is a self-contained housing unit (a type of residential real estate) that occupies only part of a building (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apartment).

House.label: House
House.comment: A house is a building or structure that has the ability to be occupied for habitation by humans or other creatures (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House).

Accommodation.label: Accommodation
Accommodation.comment: An accommodation is a place that can accommodate human beings, e.g. a hotel room, a camping pitch, or a meeting room. Many accommodations are for overnight stays, but this is not a mandatory requirement. For more specific types of accommodations not defined in

Place.label: Place
Place.comment: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical extension.

Service.label: Service
Service.comment: A service provided by an organization, e.g. delivery service, print services, etc.

LegalService.label: Legal service
LegalService.comment: A LegalService is a business that provides legally-oriented services, advice and representation, e.g. law firms.\n\nAs a LocalBusiness it can be described as a provider of one or more Service\(s).

JobPosting.label: Job posting
JobPosting.comment: A listing that describes a job opening in a certain organization.

Occupation.label: Occupation
Occupation.comment: A profession, may involve prolonged training and/or a formal qualification.

PodcastSeries.label: Podcast series
PodcastSeries.comment: A podcast is an episodic series of digital audio or video files which a user can download and listen to.

PodcastEpisode.label: Podcast episode
PodcastEpisode.comment: A single episode of a podcast series.

MediaObject.label: Media object
MediaObject.comment: A media object, such as an image, video, audio, or text object embedded in a web page or a downloadable dataset i.e. DataDownload. Note that a creative work may have many media objects associated with it on the same web page. For example, a page about a single

ImageGallery.label: Image gallery
ImageGallery.comment: Web page type: Image gallery page.

BreadcrumbList.label: Breadcrumb list
BreadcrumbList.comment: A BreadcrumbList is an ItemList consisting of a chain of linked Web pages, typically described using at least their URL and their name, and typically ending with the current page.\n\nThe position property is used to reconstruct the order of the items in a Brea

SiteNavigationElement.label: Site navigation element
SiteNavigationElement.comment: A navigation element of the page.

ItemList.label: Item list
ItemList.comment: A list of items of any sort—for example, Top 10 Movies About Weathermen, or Top 100 Party Songs. Not to be confused with HTML lists, which are often used only for formatting.

ListItem.label: List item
ListItem.comment: An list item, e.g. a step in a checklist or how-to description.

ContactPoint.label: Contact point
ContactPoint.comment: A contact point—for example, a Customer Complaints department.

GeoCoordinates.label: Geo coordinates
GeoCoordinates.comment: The geographic coordinates of a place or event.

OpeningHoursSpecification.label: Opening hours specification
OpeningHoursSpecification.comment:
A structured value providing information about the opening hours of a place or a certain service inside a place.

Question.label: Question
Question.comment: A specific question - e.g. from a user seeking answers online, or collected in a Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) document.

Answer.label: Answer
Answer.comment: An answer offered to a question; perhaps correct, perhaps opinionated or wrong.

HowToStep.label: How-to step
HowToStep.comment: A step in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It is an ordered list with HowToDirection and/or HowToTip items.

SpeakableSpecification.label: Speakable specification
SpeakableSpecification.comment: A SpeakableSpecification indicates (typically via xpath or cssSelector) sections of a document that are highlighted as particularly speakable. Instances of this type are expected to be used primarily as values of the speakable property.

Rating.label: Rating
Rating.comment: A rating is an evaluation on a numeric scale, such as 1 to 5 stars.

EntryPoint.label: Entry point
EntryPoint.comment: An entry point, within some Web-based protocol.

PriceSpecification.label: Price specification
PriceSpecification.comment: A structured value representing a price or price range. Typically, only the subclasses of this type are used for markup. It is recommended to use MonetaryAmount to describe independent amounts of money such as a salary, credit card limits, etc.

UnitPriceSpecification.label: Unit price specification
UnitPriceSpecification.comment: The price asked for a given offer by the respective organization or person.

MonetaryAmount.label: Monetary amount
MonetaryAmount.comment: A monetary value or range. This type can be used to describe an amount of money such as $50 USD, or a range as in describing a bank account being suitable for a balance between £1,000 and £1,000,000 GBP, or the value of a salary, etc. It is recommended to use

QuantitativeValue.label: Quantitative value
QuantitativeValue.comment: A point value or interval for product characteristics and other purposes.

Optician.label: Optician
Optician.comment: A store that sells reading glasses and similar devices for improving vision.

HomeAndConstructionBusiness.label: Home and construction business
HomeAndConstructionBusiness.comment:
A construction business.

A HomeAndConstructionBusiness is a LocalBusiness that provides services around homes and buildings.

As a LocalBusiness it can be described as a provider of one or more Service\(s).

HVACBusiness.label: Hvacbusiness
HVACBusiness.comment: A business that provides Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning services.

Attorney.label: Attorney
Attorney.comment: Professional service: Attorney. \n\nThis type is deprecated - LegalService is more inclusive and less ambiguous.

AccountingService.label: Accounting service
AccountingService.comment: Accountancy business.\n\nAs a LocalBusiness it can be described as a provider of one or more Service\(s).

Motel.label: Motel
Motel.comment: A motel. See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

Hostel.label: Hostel
Hostel.comment: A hostel - cheap accommodation, often in shared dormitories. See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

BedAndBreakfast.label: Bed and breakfast
BedAndBreakfast.comment: Bed and breakfast. See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

VacationRental.label: Vacation rental
VacationRental.comment: A kind of lodging business that focuses on renting single properties for limited time.

Campground.label: Campground
Campground.comment: A camping site, campsite, or Campground is a place used for overnight stay in the outdoors, typically containing individual CampingPitch locations. \n\n In British English a campsite is an area, usually divided into a number of pitches, where people can camp o

Resort.label: Resort
Resort.comment: A resort is a place used for relaxation or recreation, attracting visitors for holidays or vacations. Resorts are places, towns or sometimes commercial establishments operated by a single company (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikiped

HobbyShop.label: Hobby shop
HobbyShop.comment: A store that sells materials useful or necessary for various hobbies.

LiquorStore.label: Liquor store
LiquorStore.comment: A shop that sells alcoholic drinks such as wine, beer, whisky and other spirits.

MobilePhoneStore.label: Mobile phone store
MobilePhoneStore.comment: A store that sells mobile phones and related accessories.

PawnShop.label: Pawn shop
PawnShop.comment: A shop that will buy, or lend money against the security of, personal possessions.

SportsActivityLocation.label: Sports activity location
SportsActivityLocation.comment: A sports location, such as a playing field.

MiddleSchool.label: Middle school
MiddleSchool.comment: A middle school (typically for children aged around 11-14, although this varies somewhat).

GovernmentOffice.label: Government office
GovernmentOffice.comment: A government office—for example, an IRS or DMV office.

EmergencyService.label: Emergency service
EmergencyService.comment: An emergency service, such as a fire station or ER.
